data.string: Welcome!
I'm Fennel, and as you can see, I'm a scientist.
As a result of my research, we can experience the dreams of Pokémon!
Are you wondering how we do that? By entering the Pokémon Dream World!
With the help of Dream Mist and Game Sync, we can explore the memories of sleeping Pokémon.
We discovered that using Game Sync to tuck in a Pokémon will make the Pokémon have dreams.
When you use Game Sync to wake the Pokémon, its dream becomes reality in a space called the Entralink in the Unova region.
Isn't Game Sync amazing?
In this Pokémon Dream World, if you register your Game Sync ID in the Pokémon Global Link, you can experience the dream of the Pokémon you tucked in!
Oh, you have not registered your Game Sync ID.

You can check your Game Sync ID by selecting GAME SYNC SETTINGS from the main menu in Pokémon Black Version, Pokémon White Version, Pokémon Black Version 2 or Pokémon White Version 2. More on Game Sync ID.
Please register your Game Sync ID by clicking…
Activate your C-Gear in Pokémon Black Version, Pokémon White Version, Pokémon Black Version 2 or Pokémon White Version 2 to tuck in your Pokémon with Game Sync!
Touch ONLINE on your C-Gear screen, touch GAME SYNC, and choose a Pokémon you want to tuck in.
After playing in the Pokémon Dream World, wake up your sleeping Pokémon.
After you use Game Sync to wake up your Pokémon, go to the Entralink, and you'll find that your Pokémon's dream has become reality.
I have to warn you about something. Running the Game Sync requires an enormous amount of energy. So you can tuck in your Pokémon only once a day.
And this system is still under development… So there are some Pokémon that you can't tuck in.
Every day, I'm researching the saved data from users all over the world, so I can figure out how to tuck in more kinds of Pokémon!
When you arrive in the Pokémon Dream World, the first place you'll visit is a little island. I call it a home.
I gave you a special house, see? I'm counting on you to take good care of it.
In the Pokémon Dream World, you can grow Berries, visit other people's homes, and explore an island called the Island of Dreams, where Pokémon live.
I gave you some Berries, so try to grow them!
That's all from me, the dreaming Fennel!

I wonder what kind of dreams Pokémon have...
It seems you haven't tucked in a Pokémon yet...

Please come back to the Pokémon Dream World after tucking in a Pokémon.
This is your house. This island is called a home.
You can do a lot of things at your home!
You can move using the <img/><img/><img/><img/> arrows.
You can grow Berries...
...and you can swap items and Berries with other users.
You can also go to the Island of Dreams by crossing a bridge.
If you push the door of your house, you can go inside.
The mat in front of your house is a Footprint Mat. Pokémon that visited your home will leave their footprints.
When you click the <img/> button in the upper-left corner...
You can see your Dream Pals' homes!
If you click this button, you can exit the Pokémon Dream World and wake your Pokémon.
If you leave the Pokémon Dream World without clicking the button, you cannot wake up your Pokémon. So be careful!
Now, enjoy a Pokémon's dream in the Pokémon Dream World!
Here, you can see Dream Pals who became your friends in the Pokémon DW.
Please check your privacy setting in your Profile.
If you choose the Everyone privacy setting in your Profile, you can communicate with Dream Pals and other users.
This is your room. Let me explain how it works.
You have your very own Treasure Chest!
The Treasure Chest is where you can store Berries and items that you collected in the Pokémon Dream World.
You can send those Berries and items to a boy at the entrance of the Entree Forest as Dream Remnants.
When your Pokémon wakes up from a dream, you can talk to the boy at the entrance of the Entree Forest to receive the Dream Remnants.
This is a Friend Board.
You can make a wish to add a Pokémon you've met on the Island of Dreams to your party. A photo of the Pokémon you wished for will appear on this Friend Board.
The Pokémon from the Friend Board will be sent to a Forest Clearing in the Entree Forest.
I'm sure the Pokémon in the Forest Clearing will join your party!
Another thing... If you have 50 or more photos on your Friend Board, you can't go to the Island of Dreams. So keep an eye on that!
This is a Dream Catalogue. You can buy Décor items for your home!
You can buy Décor items by trading Berries for them.
You can place your Décor items anywhere you want by clicking the button.
This is the Share Shelf. You can swap items and Berries with other users.
Here's how the Share Shelf can help you!
If you click an empty space on the shelf, your Treasure Chest will open!
Pick an item that you'd like to swap.
That item is now available on the shelf! People who visit your home will be able to swap their items for yours!
You can swap items and Berries with other users.
If you don't mind, I'll explain how to use it.
Choose which one you want.
Your Treasure Chest will open, so pick an item to swap.
You can collect items and Berries on the Island of Dreams. It's fun to swap items with other players!
This is the Island of Dreams.
The Island of Dreams is a mysterious place where a lot of Pokémon live...
Even if you walk a different path every time, you'll end up at a huge tree. It's called the Tree of Dreams, and people say it can make your wishes come true!
Are you ready? Let's go! I hope you'll meet a lot of Pokémon!
You can move using the <img/><img/><img/><img/> arrows.
Oh! Something is moving. Maybe a Pokémon is hiding there!
Click the signs of movement to investigate.
The Pokémon wants to become your friend!
Let's play with the Pokémon!
If you're good at the Pokémon's game, the Pokémon will become your friend!
Click the sparkles in the air...
You can collect items and Berries on the Island of Dreams.
This is the Tree of Dreams. It's beautiful, isn't it?
There are a lot of Pokémon whose wishes came true!
I'll bet you'd like to know how to make a wish.
Click the Wishing Hollow at the base of the tree, and place a Berry inside.
The Island of Dreams remembers the Pokémon that became your friends there.
The tree will ask you which Pokémon you want to add to your party. Pick one to make your wish!
After you make a wish, you'll go back to your <font>home</font>. If you didn't befriend any Pokémon, you'll go back to your <font>home</font> without making a wish.
Oh, you didn't become friends with any Pokémon on the Island of Dreams.
If you see movement while exploring the Island of Dreams, click to investigate. You might find a hiding Pokémon!
If you meet a Pokémon, play with the Pokémon!
If you're good at the Pokémon's game, the Pokémon will become your friend!
Go back to your home and come back to the Tree of Dreams again.
This is your garden. You can grow Berries here.
Berries are very useful in the Pokémon Dream World. You can trade Berries to buy Décor items for your house. Sometimes you need Berries to play games with Pokémon.
I'll explain about how to grow Berries!
Click the soil, and you can see the Berries you have.
Choose the Berry you want to grow.
That Berry is planted!
Water the plants with a watering system and grow even more Berries!
Click the place where you planted a Berry…
...and you can water it with a watering system.
When it grows more Berries…
...you can harvest the Berries!
The harvested Berries will be put in your Treasure Chest.
Grow a lot of Berries and enjoy the Pokémon Dream World!
You can cross this bridge to go to the Island of Dreams.
The Island of Dreams is a mysterious place where a lot of Pokémon live...
I'm still investigating how Pokémon live in dreams...
If you'll send me your saved data, I can make more progress in my research. I'm counting on you!
